scope: Regular team/channel member, one persistent HTTP/1.1 client, uncompressed GET /api/v4/channels/{id}/posts?page=0&per_page=60&collapsedThreads=false. Five equally weighted page types in fixed shuffled order. Fresh database/server and all-API fixtures for each process. Timing spans request send through complete response read, excluding JSON decode/assertions; wall loop includes them. Localhost without TLS, no concurrent clients or production throughput/tail claim.
